sample_identity.pool: ESConv validation; isolated from future ESC-Eval role cards

estimands_and_reporting.primary: descriptive label prevalence for each frozen rubric dimension
report: raw numerator and denominator for every label
Wilson 95 percent interval for each binary one-vs-rest label proportion
missing and uncertain counts without recoding uncertain as failure
estimands_and_reporting.small_strata_interpretation: descriptive only; no family/rank significance claim

permitted: aggregate evidence about exact-treatment resource semantics
aggregate retriever failure-mode localization by frozen rank and family strata
transparent recommendation for general catalog/retriever repair subject to researcher review
forbidden: claiming response quality, PM effect, or ESC-Eval capability
deleting, reranking, or downweighting a candidate because a human or LLM judged state appropriateness
creating any runtime human-or-LLM utility filter
using visible redundancy or near-duplicate judgment as a semantic-threshold deletion rule
turning aggregate results into a post-hoc PASS threshold
interpretation_rule.qualification_conclusion_form: Report the observed descriptive profile and named failure modes; researcher decides whether a general pre-outcome resource/retriever repair is warranted. No binary automatic gate.

allowed_only_after_separate_deterministi: explicit visible boundary conflict for that state-candidate pair
never_hard_exclusion: predicted helpfulness, utility, response quality, or likely uptake
candidate_level_structural_hard_exclusio.human_label_role: A human structural finding triggers an auditable deterministic adjudication; the human label alone is not an active runtime exclusion.

atomicity.question: Does the treatment express one executable supporter move rather than a bundle?

state_appropriateness.question: Is this move semantically appropriate to the visible state without using hidden facts?

boundary_compatibility.question: Does it respect explicit listen-only, no-advice and no-probing boundaries?

executability.question: Can frozen Step2/Generator act on the move without extra retrieval or hidden interpretation?

leakage.question: Does the exact rendered move expose source-specific names, facts, dialogue wording or outcome?

redundancy_near_duplicate.question: Is it redundant with the visible supporter behavior or a near-duplicate of another reviewed ticket?
redundancy_near_duplicate.note: near-duplicate label is diagnostic only and never deletes a ticket by threshold

review_form_rubric.completion_instruction: For every blind_item_id, return exactly one CompletedSemanticsHumanReview row. Judge the six fixed dimensions and provide a rationale; do not score likely response quality, helpfulness, utility, or whether the PM should turn RS on.
